A modern platform for managing clinical assessments.

Easy to use. Secure. Fast. Designed to identify duplicate submissions while helping keep institutional data secure.

Why Clinical Management System (CMS)

Fewer clicks. Fewer risks.

Fast

Submit, review, and manage clinical assessments in seconds instead of relying on paper records.

Secure

Records are encrypted in transit and stored using industry-standard security practices.

Honest by design

Every submitted clinical history is checked for potential duplication, helping support academic integrity.

What's included

Beyond duplicate detection.

Role-based access Students, examiners, and administrators each see only the permissions relevant to their role.
Automatic examiner notifications Examiners are notified when new submissions are ready for review.
Institution dashboard Monitor submissions, duplicate checks, and assessment progress in one place.
Digital records Access assessment history anytime, without relying on paper files.
Academic integrity

Promoting academic integrity.

Clinical histories are compared automatically the moment they're submitted. If a submission appears substantially similar to another student's work, it is flagged for review before grading — protecting honest effort and giving every institution a record it can trust.

Automatic duplicate checksEvery submission is compared against other submissions within the institution's database
Plagiarism flags on recordFlagged submissions are routed for review
Transparent to the institutionEvery result is visible, traceable, and fair
Infrastructure

Built on trusted Google Cloud infrastructure.

Clinical Management System (CMS) is built on Google Cloud infrastructure and integrates with Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets alongside our own database — designed to keep records backed up and available.
